name: SKATOLUM
key_symptoms: Frontal headache, worse over left eye, in the evening, better by short sleep.
Gastric.--Tongue coated, foul taste. Salty taste to all cereals. Belching. Appetite increased. Light, yellow, narrow, very offensive stool. Intestinal dyspepsia.
guiding_symptoms: Frontal headache, worse over left eye, in the evening, better by short sleep.

mind_symptoms: Lack of concentration; impossible to study; despondent; desire to be with people. Irritable. Felt mean towards everyone.
